_comment: Anyone can publish a repository in this format.
A repository may set a top-level "name", shown next to its mods.
id           the mod's id: mod.json "id" for a DnW mod, the [BepInPlugin] GUID for a
BepInEx plugin, or slug(author).slug(name) for a MelonLoader mod. This is what
an installed copy is matched against, so it has to be exact.
kind         dnw | bepinex | melon - decides where a downloaded package is installed.
folder       optional; the folder name to install into when it differs from the DLL name.
aliases      other ids or DLL file names this mod has shipped under, for matching an
existing install that predates its current id.
